data_fields.name: bag_capacity
data_fields.donor_constant: none (no cap in inventory.cpp; vector grows to slot+1)

best_idea: Keep the equip zone as a fixed 18-entry array and the bag as a sparse list indexed by saved position, and never drop an item on load: a taken slot goes to the first free bag index, else to the end.
decision_why: Keep the two-zone shape and never-drop placement; change the silent stack clamp to a returned overflow, bounds-check the equip lookup, and add a server re-validation of every count on load. Donor has no atomic move, so that part is new work.
acceptance: A server test loads a save where two items claim the same equip slot and asserts both survive (one equipped, one at the first free bag index); a stack setter called with 40 on a max-20 item returns overflow 20 instead of clamping silently.
